name: Hatfield Squat
instructions: Set a safety squat bar on your back inside a power rack, holding the uprights for balance.
Unrack and take a comfortable squat stance.
Descend under control, using the hands lightly for stability — the legs do the work.
Drive through the whole foot to stand. The hand support lets you overload the legs safely.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: Hatfield Squat is an intermediate lower-body exercise that builds the quadriceps, usually performed with a safety squat bar. It trains the deep knee-and-hip bend you use every time you sit, stand, or climb stairs.
